blocks.heading: h1
blocks.title: Drop In to a Peer Support Group
blocks.lead: A free, student-led hour to talk, listen and connect with other UW–Madison students.
body: No sign-ups, no commitment, and no stigma. Come alone or bring friends — all are welcome :D

embed.title: Badger Supports on Instagram: peer support groups

steps.text: Groups meet every week. Each card shows its time and room.
Use Get Directions on your group. Rooms can change, so check before you head over.
No sign-up needed. A short check-in, an activity, then conversation. Share as much or as little as you like. Running a little late? That’s okay — just come in.

blocks.title: What a Group Is Like
blocks.lead: Free, student-led peer support for enrolled UW–Madison students.

topics.text: Peer Support Groups give you a steady space to be heard, to listen, and to connect with fellow students who understand what it means to thrive at UW.
Groups include a short check-in and an activity, with room for conversation.
Come as you are. Check the current schedule for a group that works for you.

blocks.title: Can’t make a group?
body: Badger SPILL is written peer support from Badger Supports. Write what’s on your mind, whenever it’s on your mind, and a trained UW–Madison Student Supporter writes back. It’s confidential.
Badger SPILL isn’t a crisis service. If you’re in danger, call 911, call or text 988, or call UHS 24/7 at 608-265-5600, option 9.

blocks.body: For your student organization, campus unit, or yourself!

blocks.title: Good to Know
body: Peer support groups are not a substitute for ongoing counseling and do not provide mental health treatment. Facilitators listen to shared concerns, support reflection and problem solving, and help participants experience what peer support can feel like in a supportive, student led setting.
Badger Supports values inclusion and access for all participants. Please contact accessibility@badgersupports.org about an accommodation request or an access question.
